description: fs.suid_dumpable written as 2 — root-readable dumps, which is what systemd-coredump needs to capture a setuid crash at all. It passes and is told it is not the same as 0: the privileged memory still reaches the disk. KERNEL-0005 holds the stricter bar on the running value and reports the same 2 as a low-severity finding, which is the two questions differing rather than the report contradicting itself.
